question: A 12 V car head light lamp draws a current of 3 A for 15 minutes. The energy transferred during this time by the car battery is
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.009 kWh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Calculate Power (P)**
 
• Power (P) = Voltage (V) * Current (I)
 
• P = 12 V * 3 A = **36 Watts**
 
• Convert Time to Hours
 
• Time (t) = 15 minutes = 15/60 hours = 0.25 hours
 
• Calculate Energy Transferred in Kilowatt-hours (kWh)
 
• Energy (E) = Power (P) * Time (t)
 
• E = 36 Watts * 0.25 hours = 9 Watt-hours
 
• E = 9/1000 kilowatt-hours =** 0.009 kWh**
 
• **Therefore, the energy transferred by the car battery during this time is 0.009 kilowatt-hours.**
